# The 21st Brigade
The 21st Mechanized Cavalry Brigade was deployed to the Colossus sector in the wake of the 404th division taking heavy losses from constant conflict between pirate fleets and PDV funded terrorist cells. With the loss of their commander and much of their command staff, the remnants of the 404th merged under the 21st, their members spread out between the various Squadrons.
The 21st is a unique Mechanized Cavalry Brigade, trained and outfitted to fight on the frontier with limited support. Instead of being assigned to a fleet, it has a naval detachment that works with the 21st's Colonel and the Squadron COs to get the marines where they need to go. This naval detachment includes a number of formidable ships, including the TSFMC Battleship 'Halcyon', the main Forward Operating Base of the TSFMC in the Colossus Sector.
The 5th Squadron, nicknamed the 'Party Crashers' is the 21st's heavy infantry and Mechanized Squadron.Their role in operations is to be the hammer that breaks their enemy's backs. These marines tend to favor excessive demolitions, heavy weaponry, and are the first on the front line. In times of low conflict, or the need for additional shipside security arises, elements of the 5th Squadron also do double duty as a form of Military Police.
The 9th Squadron, nicknamed the 'Eagle's Eyes', is the 21st's support Squadron. Elements of this unit heavily includes logistics and support personnel, but also contains its own Troops of Light Infantry. Should the 5th Squadron encounter issues, or require back up, the 9th Squadron provides backup and rear guard. The TSFMC Combat Engineer and TSFN Medical detachments fall under this Squadron's command as well, for continuity.
Marines fresh from boot camp (also known as 'boots'), transferring from other units, or waking up from cryo for the first time, will find themselves assigned to a Troop (Company sized unit) under one of these Squadrons (Battalion sized unit).
